top_signals.title: Anthropic Results May Aid IPO But Not AI Trade
top_signals.summary: Anthropic PBC’s third-quarter results may strengthen the case for its expected initial public offering, though signs that revenue growth slowed from earlier in the year are likely to deepen questions over the global AI trade, according to some investors and analysts.
